name: ChatGPT
summary: Chat, write, code help, image generation, voice and deep research in one app, with custom GPTs for repeat tasks.
pros: Widest feature set of any chatbot
cons: Free tier limits bite at busy times
bodyHtml:
Chat, write, code help, image generation, voice and deep research in one app, with custom GPTs for repeat tasks.

Free to start. Plus $20/mo. Watch out: free tier limits bite at busy times

name: Claude
summary: Natural, careful writing and reasoning over very long documents. Projects keep related chats and files together.
cons: Rolling usage caps on paid plans
bodyHtml:
Natural, careful writing and reasoning over very long documents. Projects keep related chats and files together.

Free to start. Pro $20/mo. Watch out: rolling usage caps on paid plans

name: Gemini
summary: Google's assistant across Gmail, Docs and Drive, with strong multimodal skills and Veo video generation through Flow.
cons: Plan names and bundles change often
bodyHtml:
Google's assistant across Gmail, Docs and Drive, with strong multimodal skills and Veo video generation through Flow.

Free to start. AI Pro $19.99/mo. Watch out: plan names and bundles change often

name: Perplexity
summary: Ask a question, get a clear answer with citations you can open and check. The fastest way to research a new topic.
bodyHtml:
Ask a question, get a clear answer with citations you can open and check. The fastest way to research a new topic.

Free to start. Pro $20/mo. Watch out: citations still need spot-checking

name: NotebookLM
summary: Upload PDFs, notes and lectures; ask questions answered only from your sources, and generate audio overviews to revise on the go.
bestFor: Best for studying your own documents
bodyHtml:
Upload PDFs, notes and lectures; ask questions answered only from your sources, and generate audio overviews to revise on the go.

Free to start. Free. Watch out: only knows what you upload

name: Claude Code
summary: A terminal-based agent that reads your whole project, writes and edits code, runs tests and fixes errors. Included with Claude Pro and Max.
bodyHtml:
A terminal-based agent that reads your whole project, writes and edits code, runs tests and fixes errors. Included with Claude Pro and Max.

Paid-only tool. In Claude Pro $20/mo. Watch out: needs a paid Claude plan

name: GitHub Copilot
summary: AI pair programmer inside VS Code and other editors: line and function completions, chat and multi-file edits without leaving your IDE.
cons: Best value for daily coders only
bodyHtml:
AI pair programmer inside VS Code and other editors: line and function completions, chat and multi-file edits without leaving your IDE.

Free to start. Free tier + paid plans. Watch out: best value for daily coders only

name: Midjourney
summary: The benchmark for striking AI images — art, product shots and concept work with a distinctive, polished look.
bodyHtml:
The benchmark for striking AI images — art, product shots and concept work with a distinctive, polished look.

Paid-only tool. Paid plans. Watch out: no free plan; learning curve

name: Canva AI
summary: Magic Studio tools inside Canva: generate images, remove backgrounds, resize for every platform and keep your brand kit applied.
pros: Design and AI in one place
cons: AI credits are limited on Free
bodyHtml:
Magic Studio tools inside Canva: generate images, remove backgrounds, resize for every platform and keep your brand kit applied.

Free to start. Free + Pro plans. Watch out: aI credits are limited on Free

name: Runway
summary: Text-to-video generation plus a full editor: motion control, green screen, inpainting and scene extension for creators.
cons: Good clips still take several tries
bodyHtml:
Text-to-video generation plus a full editor: motion control, green screen, inpainting and scene extension for creators.

Free to start. Free credits + paid plans. Watch out: good clips still take several tries

name: Grammarly
summary: Grammar, clarity and tone suggestions everywhere you type — email, docs and social — plus AI rewrites when you are stuck.
pros: Works in every app you write in
cons: Style advice can flatten your voice
bodyHtml:
Grammar, clarity and tone suggestions everywhere you type — email, docs and social — plus AI rewrites when you are stuck.

Free to start. Free + Pro plans. Watch out: style advice can flatten your voice

name: ElevenLabs
summary: Realistic text-to-speech in many languages, voice cloning and dubbing — the go-to for narration, ads and video voiceovers.
bodyHtml:
Realistic text-to-speech in many languages, voice cloning and dubbing — the go-to for narration, ads and video voiceovers.

Free to start. Free tier + paid plans. Watch out: best voices need paid credits
